title.narrative: Enhancing the resilience of civil society in the Eastern Partnership (ERICS-EaP)

description.narrative:
The global objective of the proposed framework partnership closely aligns with TF¿s strategic plan for enhancing civil society in the Eastern neighbourhood of the European Union. This global objective is to increase the capacity and efficiency of civil society to promote open, inclusive and resilient societies and to advance democratic systems of governance in the Eastern Partnership countries and Russia.

In this pursuit, the programme has the following specific objectives:

1. To improve the financial and resource base of civil society in the region

2. To provide key segments of regional civil society with targeted capacity-building for improved outreach, impact, visibility, accountability, and management

3. To enable civil society to effectively embed with citizens, communities, and constituencies and to link them to all layers of government

4. To enhance regional and international cooperation and exchange through civil society platforms and networks

5. To advance the contribution of civil society to policy analysis and discourse at local, national, regional, European, and international levels
